notes.title: Update for visual performance and scene environments
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245514/b1bc4e3dde20bca8fd67e61b8062c4efac482ba1.png"]

This pack is a big update for game's visual performance. There are 3 new kinds of scene environments added to the game. They are Deep Blue Exploration, Dragon Lava, Emerald Base. There are 15 levels in total has been changed to new visual types. The game experience is quite different from before. Actually it's much cooler. 

And there are some small changes on scene settings in some levels to optimize game experience.

notes.title: Update for multi-language support
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245514/66c57cd419d46f6510b400bd99f7878841d5d674.png

This pack is for multi-language support. There are 6 languages added to the game. They are French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Russian. And there will be more languages added soon.
